ニコンFマウント用広角ズームレンズ 「AF-S NIKKOR 18-35mm f/3.5-4.5G ED」 です。
フルサイズようのレンズですが、ＡＰＳーＣフォーマットのカメラにも装着しても軽量なので取り回しは良いです。
外観目立つキズや打痕、塗装剥がれ、スレ等ありません。
レンズ内も、キズ、カビ、クモリ等なく、きれいな状態です。
各部、操作間もスムーズで、性能、機能上の不具合はありません。
純正の前後レンズキャップ、レンズフード、取説、布製収納袋が付いています。
また、当初から装着していた、77ｍｍ薄枠の保護用レンズフイターもお付けします。
梱包サイズは、６０サイズになります。

post.description: Start here to find auction ids (then call item) or to get sold-price history for a keyword. Provide at least one of query, category_id or seller_id.

category_id.description:
Yahoo! Auctions category id (0 = all). Ids come from category_facets or from item/search category_path.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

conditions.description: Item condition codes (NEW, USED10 unused-like ... USED80 heavily used).

limit.description:
limit

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50; default 20.

max_price.description:
Maximum current price in JPY.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

min_price.description:
Minimum current price in JPY.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

offset.description:
Result offset; pass next_offset from the previous page.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 10000; default 0.

seller_id.description: Seller aucUserId as returned in items[].seller.user_id or item.seller.user_id. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}$.

sort.description:
Site sort key. Default -RANKING for OPEN and -END_TIME for CLOSED.

Provider reference: allowed values ["-RANKING", "-FIRST_START_TIME", "+END_TIME", "-END_TIME", "+PRICE", "-PRICE"].

status.description:
OPEN = live auctions; CLOSED = ended auctions (sold-price history, statistics included).

Provider reference: allowed values ["OPEN", "CLOSED"]; default "OPEN".

Auctions Japan listings by keyword, category and/or seller. status OPEN lists live auctions; status CLOSED lists ended auctions with their final price and adds avg/min/max sold-price statistics for the whole result set.
